decisions.decision: Owner-selected standard core remains default. Optional packet chronology applies only within explicitly revised selections.
Exact duplicate hashes are aliases of one source, not independent corroboration or new authority. The preferred path need not be alphabetical duplicateOf target.
Combined1–8 dex is a textual composition of four supplied books, not a uniform revised edition. Select authority per component and content.
Bulbasaur ability slots match supplied1.05+; standard old/combined profile differs. Attribution is resolved; the inherited whole record is not approved.
Supplement toolkits are additive optional source candidates. Their recommendations and optional rules never silently replace standard core.
